keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Teaneck Township, homeowners pay an average of $13,192.2 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.44% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 67.5%, assessed values average ~67.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 59.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 29.8%, and Bergen County claims 11.0%.
